other_conditions: PwD must be older than 18 years
PwD must have a disability covered under the National Trust Act (Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation or Multiple Disabilities)
The applicant organization must be registered with the National Trust and hold a valid registration under the PwD Act 1995 at the time of enrolment
The group home land must be owned by the organization or leased for at least 10 years with a provision for renewal
The organization must have at least 2 years of experience working with persons with disabilities, including at least one year of experience with one of the four specified disabilities
The organization must not be blacklisted by the National Trust or any other Government organization on the date of submission
benefits_summary: Provides an assured home with quality care services, including basic medical care and vocational support, throughout the life of the person with disability.
